name: Crude-to-chemicals complexes
applications: maximum olefins and aromatics from crude
reducing exposure to falling fuel demand
principle: A refinery is configured to send most of its crude to petrochemical feedstocks rather than fuels. Deep conversion such as hydrocracking and resid upgrading makes naphtha and gas oils for steam crackers and aromatics complexes, so a large share of each barrel ends as ethylene, propylene, paraxylene and other chemicals.

process_steps.name: Derivatives
equipment: polyethylene, polypropylene, PTA, other derivative plants

reference_plants.name: PETRONAS Pengerang RAPID (PIC), Johor
reference_plants.capacity: 300 kb/d refinery with 3.3 Mt/yr petrochemical capacity; PETRONAS and Saudi Aramco joint ventures
reference_plants.status: refinery start-up targeted Q1 2019 at time of release

limitations: Large energy use and CO2 emissions
